name: Matryoshka-Compatible Dimension Truncation
mechanism: Uses an encoder explicitly trained or adapted so prefixes of the full embedding remain useful at smaller indexed dimensions.
use_when: Index memory or ANN latency is binding
The exact model documents nested-dimension training
avoid_when: The model was not trained for nested dimensions
Quality at the target dimension lacks private replay evidence
expected_effects: One model can support evaluated capacity tiers
failure_modes: Dimension and normalization mismatch query and document indexes
